# Six Degrees of Cinema

> A daily Hollywood movie trivia puzzle: connect two movie stars in six degrees or fewer using acting and directing credits.

Six Degrees of Cinema is a web-based game inspired by the classic "Six Degrees of Kevin Bacon" parlor game. Players are given two randomly selected actors and must build a chain that connects them through shared movie or directing credits, using six steps or fewer. The game offers a daily challenge (same pair worldwide), a survival streak mode, and configurable difficulty and era settings.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Start a new game, pick mode/era/difficulty, or launch the daily challenge or survival streak.

## Optional

- [Daily Challenge](/): The same actor pair every day, shared by every player worldwide.
